title: The Restricted Geometric Langlands Equivalence in Positive Characteristic
main_claim: In characteristic p>0 (with l≠p), the Gaitsgory–Raskin restricted Langlands functor Shv_Nilp(Bun_G) -> IndCoh_Nilp(Y') is onto all of IndCoh_Nilp(LS^restr), i.e. Y'=Y (GR Conjecture 1.3.10). This holds in regime A (curve and split group descend to F_q, with the four AGKRRV characteristic conditions) and in regime B (any algebraically closed k, p very good, p not dividing |W|). A rational-coefficient support corollary is also given.

issues.description: The paper extends a K-point of the proper chain space over R' using the valuative criterion. For proper algebraic spaces (as opposed to schemes), the existence part of that criterion may need a further finite extension of the fraction field. The argument already allows finite trait replacements, so this is harmless, but the text applies the criterion directly over R' without saying so.
issues.evidence: "This point descends to a finite extension of Frac(R)... The valuative criterion extends the descended point over R'"

coverage:
I read the whole LaTeX source for Sections 1–7 (introduction; specialization and the missing-component object F; Hecke vanishing with an arbitrary leg; Lie-theoretic Levi/cocharacter input in both regimes; the transverse modification with both relative derivatives; the two-Hecke isolation and étale quadratic coordinates; the projective quadric and incidence triangles; the finite slice and its nearby-cycle computation; the final contradiction). I also read Section 9 (rational coefficients) and the first half of Section 8 (consequences).

Checks made:
- Cartan-determinant/Cauchy–Binet argument: verified that rank U_k = rank V_k = rank C_k.
- Determinant table and the A_{p-1} sub-Levi reduction: verified.
- Moore-matrix additive interpolation for the Jordan parts in regime B: verified.
- Weyl averaging: verified that Λ^{W_M} = X_*(Z(M)).
- Tangent dimension of the Hecke orbit: dim L/I = <2ρ, μ> = m, verified.
- Residue pairing and invertibility of ad(a) on the weight blocks: verified.
- Cotangent identities: the leg covector ξ = κ(a0, dλ)dt, and the matching of S_A to the fixed-input fiber and S_{A'} to the fixed-output fiber: verified.
- Smooth-hypersurface steps: verified that W -> B (output map) and the punctured part of Z_w -> B are smooth.
- Dimensions behind the étaleness of Φ: N+1+2m on both sides, verified.
- Exact quadratic identity f(c) - f(r) = Σ u_i v_i: verified.
- Quadric cone cohomology: computed in python for m = 1..5; the cone is exactly E(-m)[-2m], as the paper states.
- Incidence triangle: verified.
- Krull-dimension and quasi-finiteness argument giving a nonzero finite direct sum of stalks: verified.

Cited external results (GR, AGKRRV, Hansen–Scholze, Hemo–Richarz–Scholbach) were taken as stated; I did not verify them independently.
